'''Anodyne''' was a medical compound in use during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] and [[Galactic War]]. The medical [[Starship/Legends|starship]] [[Anodyne (starship)|''Anodyne'']] was named after the substance.
